info.title: mc-api-server
info.description:
Lightweight HTTP wrapper for managing Minecraft server instances, the
remote backend for minecraft-bot.

Generated from the router by `npm run openapi:generate`. Do not edit by hand.

Every route except `GET /health` requires the `x-api-key` header. Every
non-2xx body is `{ "error": "<message>" }`. Clients negotiate by the
feature names and versions in `GET /manifest`, not by wrapper version.

get.description: Process liveness and RCON responsiveness reported separately, plus systemd restart-loop detection.
The version handshake plus whole-machine CPU and memory, the server process, and per-directory disk usage.

get.summary: Live log lines as server-sent events
get.description: Holds the connection open. Each log line is one `data:` event; comment lines (`:heartbeat`) keep idle connections alive.

get.summary: The end of the server log

get.description: Disabled mods are left out: they are not on the running server.

post.description: Runs the suite's add-mod script. A handled failure is `{ ok: false, error, code }` at 200.

post.summary: Disable a mod without uninstalling it
Start a mod compatibility check for a Minecraft version
post.description: Checks every installed mod for a release on `mcVersion` and the installed loader, in the background. One job runs per version: a second request returns the running job. A finished answer is reused for six hours unless `refresh` is set (body or `?refresh=1`) or a mod changed.

get.summary: Progress and result of a mod compatibility check
get.description: Finished jobs are kept for about 15 minutes; after that the job id is unknown (404) and the check can be started again.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id from the start request.

get.summary: Installed mods with versions and enabled state
Whether the server process is up
get.description: Legacy boolean. True for `online` and `unresponsive`; read /health to tell them apart.

post.summary: Run one of the suite's management scripts
post.description: A script that ran returns 200 with its output and exit code, including a non-zero exit. Only a failure to run it is a 500.

command.description: At most 1400 bytes, no control characters.

CommandResult.description: The console's reply. `null` when the command went through the screen fallback, which has no reply channel.

format.description: File type by extension: toml, json, json5, properties, cfg, conf, ini, yaml, text or snbt.

editable.description: False when the file is listed but cannot be read or written.

Manifest.description: What this wrapper serves; see src/contracts/manifest.ts.

ModAddResult.description: Result of add-mod.js. A handled failure is `{ ok: false, error, code }` at 200.

ModCompatJob.description: A mod compatibility check. `checkedAt`, `complete`, `summary` and `mods` are present once `state` is `done`; `error` when it is `failed`.

partial.description: Results so far while running; empty once finished.

complete.description: True when every mod got a definitive answer (no `unknown`). Set once done.

ModCompatStarted.description: The job to poll for the result.

PlayerList.description: `playerCount` and `maxPlayers` are strings; maxPlayers is "?" when unknown.

ScriptResult.description: A script that ran. A non-zero exit is still a 200.

args.description: Up to five arguments of letters, digits, `.`, `@`, `_` and `-`.
